paite: Huaiziak in Pathian ma leh akilatna leh alalgam a misi leh mihing tung a vai hawm dingpa, Toupa Jesu Khrist ma ah mohpuakna ka hon guan hi.
heading: Paul Leh Pahtakman

paite: Thu gen in; ahun hi in ahun lou ah leng pang zel in; thuakzoutak a thuhilh kawm in asiamlouhdan uh theisak inla, taihilh inla, hanthawn in,
thuhilhna dik angaihkhiak ngap louh hun uh ahong tung ding a; abilte uh azau ziak in amau deihlam bang in heutute akiang uah akhawm ding uh;
abilte uh thutak lam ah angongsak ding ua, tangthu lam naih in apialta ding uhi.
Nang zaw bangkim ah pilvang in, gimthuak inla, tanchinhoih genna lam nna sem in na nasepna pen hihtangtung in.
Kei zaw tu in leng luikhiak in ka om lellel a, ka pawt hun atungta hi.
Douna hoih tuh ka dou khinta a, kitaitehna ka tai khinta, ginna ka lenkip paisuakta hi.
Tu'n ah zaw kei a ding in Diktatna Lallukhu koih in a-omta, Toupa vaihawmpa diktat in huai ni chiang in kei ahon pe ding, kei kiang kia hilou in akilakna it peuhmahte kiang ah ape sam ding hi.
Kintak in ka kiang a hong pai pah hon tum in; Dema in tulai khovel a-it ziak in hon paisan a,
heading: Mimal Kithuhilhnate

paite: Thessalonika ah apaita hi; Galatia gam ah Kristens apai a, Dalmatia gam ah Titas apaita hi.
Luka kia ka kiang ah a-om hi. Marka chial inla, hon pi in, amah nasepna lam ah kei a ding in aphatuam hi.
Ephesa ah Taikika ka sawlta.
Na hong pai chiang in Troas a Karpas kiang a puanaktual ka nutsiat, laibute toh hon tawi in, savun lai mahmah hon tawi in.
Alexander, dalsun siampa, ka tung ah agilou mahmah hi.
Toupa'n athilhih bang zel in athuk ding; amah lak ah nang leng pilvang in, i thu adou mahmah hi.
Ka siamna thu ka gen masakpen in kuama'n ahon gum kei ua, ahon zuausan vek uhi; amoh pua in om tuan kei uhen.
Tanchinhoih keimah ziak a hilhkim a a-omtheihna ding leh Zentelte'n azaktheihna ding un, Toupa'n hon gum a ahon hihhat zawta hi; humpinelkai kam a kipan in suahtaksak in ka omta hi.
Toupa'n gitlouhna tengteng lak a kipan in ahon suaktasak dia, avan-gam ah bittak in ahon tun ding; ama kiang ah tangtawn in thupina om hen. Amen.
Priscilla leh Akuila, Onesiphoras inkuanpihte toh, chibai hon buksak in.
heading: Chibai Bukna Nanungte

paite: Korinth ah Erastas a-om gige a, Trophimas bel Melita ah damlou in ka nusia hi.
Phalbi ma in hong pai teitei in, Iubalas, Pudens, Linas, Klaudia leh unau tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist in na kha ompih hen. Na kiang ah hehpihna om hen. Amen.
